Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

"Date: January 2025\n\nLeo Park\u2019s approved involvement in Compass v0.1 was limited to a lightweight first read on data/platform seams and release-discipline or event-provenance checks. January\u2019s center of gravity remained Mercury activation: workspace creation \u2192 first source connected \u2192 first live sync, with teammate-invite and admin-role basics."
